long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Rishon LeZion, Moshe Gindi worked in his father’s electrical-appliance shop before joining his elder brother Abraham’s property brokerage. He and his younger brother Yigal became skilled apartment marketers, then founded their own development company in 1975. The partners bought land and built thousands of homes across central Israel, pairing aggressive advertising with direct sales.

After the family’s earlier businesses collapsed, Moshe and Yigal rebuilt around Gold Mall, which opened in their home city in 1993 and became a major retail-property success. They later expanded into offices, residential development and supplementary finance for other developers. Gindi also channelled capital and experience into companies led by his sons, daughters and sons-in-law, helping move the family enterprise to a second generation.
long_biography.html:
Born in Rishon LeZion, Moshe Gindi worked in his father’s electrical-appliance shop before joining his elder brother Abraham’s property brokerage. He and his younger brother Yigal became skilled apartment marketers, then founded their own development company in 1975. The partners bought land and built thousands of homes across central Israel, pairing aggressive advertising with direct sales.

After the family’s earlier businesses collapsed, Moshe and Yigal rebuilt around Gold Mall, which opened in their home city in 1993 and became a major retail-property success. They later expanded into offices, residential development and supplementary finance for other developers. Gindi also channelled capital and experience into companies led by his sons, daughters and sons-in-law, helping move the family enterprise to a second generation.
